_doc: The profile forge init writes for the checkout itself and forge add writes for each project, with project, project_path and writes_tracked_files filled in. Keys that start with _ are documentation. servers: names from config/mcp-registry.json. skills_keep and plugins_keep: left out, the project loads every skill and plugin; list names to trim it. writes_tracked_files false: forge writes no file git tracks in the project (no pointer in its CLAUDE.md, no .gitignore line). ui true: the project has a user interface, so the pointer block in its CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md also says a visual choice for the owner goes on a verdict page (written only when the checkout has scripts/design/design.py). The accepted fields and their types are PROFILE_FIELDS in forge/lib.py.
